turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My closet is overflowing. I can't find anything in there.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A good sort will help. For the stuff you don't wear anymore, do you want to donate it, sell it online, or just store it in boxes for now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't decided. Give me forty-five seconds, then ask me again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, time's up. Where are the clothes going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll sell the nice things and donate the rest.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice balance. Take photos in good daylight and the nicer pieces will sell faster.
